description.message: Shows who tried to collect information about you on the page you are on, and what happened. Fully local, kept in memory only.

a_foot.message: **Not shown:** what the site records on its own servers, details Klin does not watch (screen size, fonts, time zone), and anything that happened before this page loaded. Kept in memory only: it disappears when you close Klin.

a_empty.message: Nothing detected on this page. That does not prove nothing was collected: see what is not shown below.

a_g_other.message: Not blocked: limited or only observed
